 Edited by Abhishek Mishra / TIMESOFINDIA.COM / Updated: Nov 11, 2026, 15:13 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Terrorists target CRPF personnel, manhunt launched NEW DELHI: Two Central Reserve Police Force ( CRPF ) personnel were injured in a terror attack in Jammu and Kashmir's Kulgam district on Wednesday, news agency PTI reported. Unidentified motorcycle-borne assailants opened fire on security personnel deployed at a naka in the district before fleeing the spot. According to the CRPF, the incident took place around 2.15 pm. The injured personnel were shifted to a hospital in south Kashmir's Anantnag district for treatment. Last month, four CRPF personnel were injured in an improvised explosive device (IED) blast while defusing residual explosives at Alarmedgu camp in Chhattisgarh's Sukma district. Further details are awaited.
